verdict.rationale: Smithery once documented Triggers: a consumer activated a trigger through Smithery, the subscribe call was proxied to the MCP server, and the server POSTed events directly to the consumer. However, the subscribe path ran through Smithery's hosted connection services ('Smithery API, Connect, and Toolbox'), and Smithery's own notice says these stopped working on 2026-10-31, with the docs tree removed. Smithery now remains only a non-proxied public registry, so there is no current way to subscribe an agent to downstream events through it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them
